name: ballet-folklorico-mi-herencia
description: The bilingual site I designed and built for Ballet Folklórico Mi Herencia — the Mexican folk dance group I perform with in the San Gabriel Valley. Bookings, events, and local SEO that ranks page one and brings in real leads.

paragraphs: The official site for Ballet Folklórico Mi Herencia — the community-rooted Mexican folk dance group I perform with, based in Hacienda Heights, CA. I built and maintain this site for my group, which is available for festivals, quinceañeras, weddings, and corporate events across LA, the San Gabriel Valley, the Inland Empire, and Orange County.
Built as a fast, fully bilingual marketing site with serious local-SEO so the group gets found by people searching "folklorico for hire" in Southern California.
features: Multilingual (EN · ES · JA · 简体 · 繁體) — every language is a real, pre-rendered URL (/, /es/, /ja/, /zh/, /zh-hant/) with its own , localized /meta, self-referential canonical, and reciprocal hreflang tags — the proper…

Safe language auto-detect at the CDN edge — vercel.json redirects first-time visitors on the root / to their browser's language before any HTML downloads (zero function invocations — pure routing config, free on Hobby).…

Local SEO, done properly — descriptive , rich meta description and keywords targeting "folklorico for hire" across dozens of SoCal cities, per-language Open Graph + JSON-LD (DanceGroup, FAQPage, DanceEvent), robots.txt,…
Booking & contact — an inquiry form wired to Formspree so the group can take performance requests without a backend.

Performance-first — hand-built static pages (no framework). Shared CSS (styles.css) and JS (app.js) are linked once and cached across pages; the language pages are generated from a single source by a tiny…

requirements.text: First-time setup for the owners: sign in at /team/ with the password → Team tab → add each family with their dancers → Copy link to their upcoming gigs (or Send link on a phone) and send it to that family once (DM or text).
The link is their login; New link revokes an old one — including any answer-only sessions and calendar feeds minted from it.
